bounds.domain: One mounted map, at most two moves outside attributed bounds and three copyright requests; success, failure, late replies and disposal may interleave.
bounds.atomicity: Moves within attributed bounds retain imagery without a request. Moves outside those bounds invalidate imagery. Each matching callback publish synchronously in one JavaScript turn. Abort fences stale results even when the provider still resolves them.
bounds.progress: No fairness or availability assumption. Imagery may stay hidden while metadata is unavailable; a later current success restores it.

limitations: Does not model real MapLibre animation events, Google data completeness, browser paint ordering or physical device behavior.
The implementation scenarios run the real map-plane module against a controlled map and metadata boundary. Alpha production browser tests remain separate.
